title: How Great Are Your Works

questions.question: It is good to give thanks to the Lord, to sing praises to your name, O what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:1 (ESV): "...to sing praises to your name, O Most High;"

questions.question: To declare your steadfast love in the morning, and your faithfulness by what?
To the music of the lute and the harp, to the melody of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:3 (ESV): "...to the melody of the lyre."

questions.question: For you, O Lord, have made me glad by your work; at the works of your hands I sing for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:4 (ESV): "...at the works of your hands I sing for joy."

questions.question: How great are your works, O Lord! Your thoughts are very what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:5 (ESV): "How great are your works, O Lord! Your thoughts are very deep!"

questions.question: The stupid man cannot know; the fool cannot understand this: that though the wicked sprout like what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:7 (ESV): "...though the wicked sprout like grass..."

questions.question: And all evildoers flourish, they are doomed to destruction when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:7 (ESV): "...they are doomed to destruction forever;"

questions.question: But you, O Lord, are on high when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:8 (ESV): "but you, O Lord, are on high forevermore."

questions.question: For behold, your enemies, O Lord, for behold, your enemies shall perish; all evildoers shall be what?
But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox; you have poured over me fresh what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:10 (ESV): "...you have poured over me fresh oil."

questions.question: The righteous flourish like the palm tree and grow like a cedar in where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:12 (ESV): "The righteous flourish like the palm tree and grow like a cedar in Lebanon."

questions.question: They are planted in the house of the Lord; they flourish in the courts of our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:13 (ESV): "They are planted in the house of the Lord; they flourish in the courts of our God."

questions.question: They still bear fruit in old age; they are ever full of sap and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:14 (ESV): "they are ever full of sap and green,"

questions.question: To declare that the Lord is upright; he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:15 (ESV): "...and there is no unrighteousness in him."

questions.question: What instrument is explicitly mentioned as having ten strings?
questions.explanation: Psalm 92:3 (ESV): "to the music of the lute and the harp," (Other translations specify ten-stringed lyre/lute).

key_verse_text: It is good to give thanks to the Lord, to sing praises to your name, O Most High; to declare your steadfast love in the morning, and your faithfulness by night.
